description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeSupervisorAPI class within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It verifies API methods such as getOne, getAll, create, update, delete, and related validation rules, focusing on employee supervisor relationships and reporting methods.

classes.name: EmployeeSupervisorAPITest
classes.description: Unit test suite for the EmployeeSupervisorAPI class, covering methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting employee supervisor relationships, as well as validation logic.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportingMethodService
methods.description: Verifies that the API correctly returns an instance of EmployeeReportingMethodService.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodConfigurationService
methods.description: Verifies that the API correctly returns an instance of ReportingMethodConfigurationService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single supervisor-reporting method relationship, verifying proper normalization and metadata.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Checks the validation rules for the getOne API method, ensuring access control based on user roles.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Checks the validation rules for the getAll API method.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of supervisors for an employee, verifying normalization and meta data.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new supervisor relationship and verifies the response structure.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates the creation input parameters are properly validated.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a supervisor relationship, including fetching existing data and updating it.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks validation rules for the update operation.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting supervisor relationships for an employee, ensuring correct DAO interaction and handling not found cases.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies validation rules for the delete API operation.
